summary.text: Mallory McMorrow is a Democratic member of the Michigan Senate representing District 8, which includes Northwest Detroit and 10 municipalities in Oakland County.
According to her caucus biography she was first elected in 2018 and serves as Senate Majority Whip.

paragraphs.text: Before her election, McMorrow worked as an industrial designer and creative director, and she is a graduate of the University of Notre Dame.

Her caucus biography says she authored the state's first Extreme Risk Protection Order law and has worked on repealing the state's 1931 abortion ban, eliminating the retirement tax on seniors, and funding universal K-12 school meals.
She also serves on the Appropriations and Elections and Ethics committees and the Joint Committee on Administrative Rules.
She lives in Royal Oak with her husband, Ray, and their daughter, Noa.
